signIn.title: Sign in to Grok
signIn.deviceBody: Opens xAI's sign-in page and shows a code to confirm there. No Grok Build install is needed.
signIn.confirm: Confirm this code on the page that opened:
signIn.waiting: Waiting for you to confirm in the browser…
signIn.import: Import a Grok Build or CPA sign-in
signIn.importBody: Paste the contents of Grok Build's auth.json (or one entry of it) or a CPA xAI account file. Its refresh token rotates: stop using that sign-in in Grok Build or CPA afterwards, or sign in here with the device code instead.
